install: npm ci && bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if command -v pixlet >/dev/null 2>&1; then pixlet version; exit 0; fi; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) asset=pixlet_0.34.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz;; aarch64|arm64) asset=pixlet_0.34.0_linux_arm64.tar.gz;; *) echo "unsupported arch: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1;; esac; tmp=$(mktemp -d); curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/pixlet.tar.gz" "https://github.com/tidbyt/pixlet/releases/download/v0.34.0/$asset"; tar -xzf "$tmp/pixlet.tar.gz" -C "$tmp"; sudo install -m 0755 "$tmp/pixlet" /usr/local/bin/pixlet; rm -rf "$tmp"; pixlet version'
